Tab. 4.25 Sachbilanzdaten für das Modul " Strom, Hochspannung / Mittelspannung / Niederspannung, ab Netz (CH)"
reason: Tab. 4.25 (p.115) is the Sachbilanz (unit-process inventory) of the Swiss low-voltage-at-grid module: the medium-voltage electricity input, the low-voltage transmission network, the SF6 emission and the distribution losses — exactly the flows this 'Electricity, low voltage, production from hard coal, at grid' dataset is built from (the production route only changes which upstream medium-voltage electricity is drawn). Tab. 4.24 on p.114 gives the input data (losses, SF6 rates, network lengths) that feed it, so the range starts there; p.116 is included because Tab. 4.25 can run over. Tab. 4.19 (p.109) is the network infrastructure dataset itself, not the at-grid module, and Tab. 4.31 (p.119) is the Chinese, not the Swiss, low-voltage grid.
